rules.statement: A partnership in the opium business is illegal when an unlicensed person claims to have been a partner and has actively engaged in furthering its interests.
rules.supporting_quote: "Section 6 of the Opium Ordinance of 1899 (No. 5 of 1899) is sufficient to stamp with illegality and render unenforceable rights arising under a partnership in the opium business, when an unlicensed person claiming, as the appellant does here and under document P 1, to' have been a partner has been engaged as such in furthering its interests"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 6 of the Opium Ordinance of 1899 (No. 5 of 1899)
